title: Zero Rows and Columns
commonMistakes: Letting newly created zeros trigger additional row or column clears
Marking rows but not columns, or the reverse
Changing the input matrix instead of returning a new one
Skipping cells whose row and column are both unaffected
followUps: How would you do this with O(1) extra space using matrix markers?
What if only rows should be cleared, not columns?
How would you handle a sparse matrix stored as coordinate pairs?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
